Maya (Docs): Heads-up 1 opened a PR to modernize code snippets across SDK docs: unify streaming patterns, switch pagination examples from `cursor` to `page_token`, and add an explicit note about retry/backoff defaults. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

Ravi (SDK): I9ll take TS + Go. Any stylistic constraints?

Maya (Docs): Keep examples minimal. For streaming prefer async iterators in JS/TS and context managers for Python. Remove any `cursor: null` usage to avoid confusion. Also add a single-line reference to client retry defaults (default: 3 attempts, exponential backoff).

Kira (DevEx): Python should show both sync and async. Proposed async example:
```py
async with client.responses.stream(model=\"rwd-large\", input=\"Summarize the log\") as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.output_text, end=\"\")
```
Sync example can use a generator returned by client.responses.stream_sync(...). Keep method names stable.

Ravi (SDK): TS draft I plan to push:
```ts
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-large', input: 'Summarize the log' });
for await (const part of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(part.output_text);
}
// client.config.retry defaults to { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential' }
```
And Go:
```go
stream, err := client.Responses.Stream(ctx, api.StreamRequest{Model: \"rwd-large\", Input: \"Summarize the log\"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for stream.Next() {
  ch := stream.Value()
  fmt.Print(ch.OutputText)
}
```

Tom (ENG-ML): Add a short runtime bullet: streaming + KV-cache isn't available on heavily quantized tiny variants (example: rwd-tiny-q). Also mention that partial-chunk retries may reorder delivery; callers should be tolerant of chunk boundaries.

docs-link-bot: link-check: found broken anchor in /docs/guides/pagination -> `#old-cursor-demo` and one bad relative path in /docs/sdks/go-examples.md -> ../reference/clients.md (404).

Maya (Docs): I'll fix anchors and update the style guide to recommend stable anchors. Ravi, please remove any leftover `cursor` fields from your examples and re-run the docs link-check locally. Kira, can you add a tiny snippet-based regression test that exercises streaming and asserts chunks include `output_text`?

Ravi (SDK): Will do. Branch name: docs/snippets/stream-page-912. I9ll push TS+Go changes tonight. Also will add an inline caveat about quantized models on the streaming page.

Kira (DevEx): Sure 1 I9ll add a minimal test in snippets-ci that runs the JS streaming example in a sandbox and validates shape. Also add a test for pagination using `page_token` semantics returning `nextPageToken`.

Maya (Docs): Thanks. One more thing: add a short migration note under Guides -> Pagination: "If you previously used `cursor`, migrate to server-issued `page_token` or streaming iterators depending on client needs." Keep it 2-3 sentences.

Ravi (SDK): Pushed PR with changes, removed cursor, adjusted anchors, added caveat. Assigning reviews to @Kira and @Tom.

Kira (DevEx): Reviewing now. Found one remaining inline repo link in go-examples.md; replaced with absolute site path. Running link-check locally.

Tom (ENG-ML): LGTM on content. One tiny wording nit: change "may reorder delivery" to "may alter chunk boundaries during retry; order of complete tokens is preserved". That reduces alarm.

Maya (Docs): Good call, Tom. I9ll update wording in the PR. Once docs-ci and snippets-ci are green we can merge. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
